label: training-gym-r37-complete
context:
Training Gym R37 completed. All 4 exercises 10/10 (3 required test fixes — wrong expected values).

R37 RESULTS (all 10/10):
1. kmp-001 (T6) - KMP with LPS/failure function. 6 tests. Bug: ABABABA has 3 occurrences of ABA not 2.
2. topk-001 (T6) - Top-K Frequent via bucket sort. 6 tests. Bug: test expected wrong kth element.
3. splay-001 (T8) - Splay Tree with zig/zag rotations. 5 tests. Bug: insert(k) sets value=None, search returns None for found keys — test used `is not None`.
4. rabin-karp-001 (T6) - Rolling hash polynomial + Rabin-Karp search. 6 tests. First pass clean.

KEY PATTERNS:
- KMP LPS: when mismatch and length>0, backtrack to lps[length-1]
- Bucket sort topk: buckets[count].sort() for tie-breaking, iterate from n down to 1
- Splay search: track last-accessed node, splay it if not found. Use value=k to avoid None confusion.
- Rolling hash: roll = (old - old_char * base^(len-1)) * base + new_char, all mod prime

DB: 222 exercises, 387 attempts, avg 9.86
decisions: Splay tree: always use explicit value parameter in tests, never rely on None default
KMP: manually count overlapping pattern occurrences before writing assertions
Top-K: verify frequency map before asserting kth element
Rabin-Karp: always verify string match after hash collision to avoid false positives
next_steps: Design R38 exercises. Continue with: Segment Tree (range query), Bloom Filter, Aho-Corasick, or Trie with autocomplete.
